name: Unicycle
summary: One big wheel with a fork post and a saddle on top, in side view facing right; wheel spins when driving.

params.name: y
params.note: floor line: the wheel touches y

params.name: s
params.note: room scale: about 320 px wide and 400 px tall at s = 1

params.name: anim
params.note: drive = wheel spins (also on when vx is not 0)

params.name: vx
params.note: horizontal speed in px per frame (negative = left; set flip too)

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror so the unicycle faces left

author: krakujs
